text:
mia: Quick sync request from SignalPath (SI). They want a developer playbook to route SIEM alerts + OTLP traces into Datadog for their marketplace listing. Deliverables: OTLP->Datadog mapping, dashboard JSON, alert templates, packaging guidance. 2-week target. Who can own what?

alex: I can own the OTLP mapping and sample transforms. Need the SignalPath alert schema and which span attributes they require. Also confirm how we should handle PII fields.

jordan: I'll take dashboard JSON and the marketplace tile copy + short runbook for customers. Will produce an example alerts set.

samir: Packaging + infra notes from my side. For marketplace we should provide an OCI bundle + terraform; for Private installs provide Helm + KMS guidance. Also verify tracer SDK versions and exporter endpoints (hosted vs VPC).

mia: SignalPath sent over a minimal alert schema: model_id, request_id, latency_ms, error_type, user_prompt, user_id, env, severity. They want alerts mapped to Datadog monitors and spans to include model_id and request_id attributes. Retention: short 30d / long 365d.

alex: Prototype mapping sketch (OTLP pipeline) below, will redact user_prompt when pii=true and hash user_id. Also plan to set dd.alert.priority based on latency thresholds.

alex: ```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
processors:
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: model_id
        action: insert
      - key: request_id
        action: insert
      - key: user_id_hashed
        action: insert
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: ${DD_API_KEY}
    mapping:
      event.title: "{{ .attributes.model_id }} alert"
      event.tags: ["env:{{ .attributes.env }}", "partner:signalpath"]
transformations:
  - redact: user_prompt
    when:
      attributes.pii: true
  - compute: |
      if attributes.latency_ms > 500 then attributes.dd.alert.priority = "high"
```

alex: Will open PR with the pipeline and sample dashboards by Friday.

jordan: Tile bundle proposal: (1) Datadog dashboard JSON, (2) monitor templates (latency/error), (3) onboarding runbook, (4) terraform deploy module + example vars. OCI artifact + manifest recommended for marketplaces.

samir: Confirming OCI + terraform for cloud marketplaces. For Dedicated/Private we need separate packaging and a test matrix: Hosted API, Dedicated reserved GPU, Private VPC. Also include a checklist for VPN routing and firewall rules.

claudia: I'll schedule the partner kickoff with SignalPath and their SI lead. Thu 10am PT work for everyone?

mia: Timeline: Week 1 - draft mapping + dashboards. Week 2 - internal review + partner review + preflight. Owners: alex (mapping & transform), jordan (dashboards & tile copy), samir (packaging & test matrix), claudia (partner comms).

ops-bot: Preflight tasks queued: infra-lint ✔, dashboard-schema-validate queued, datadog-schema-check queued.

alex: Note: include an example alert title pattern `model:<model_id> latency>500ms` for clear support UX. Also include sample query to convert OTLP spans into Datadog trace attributes.

jordan: Will include alert title pattern and example dashboard panels for latency distribution and top error types per model.

samir: I'll add packaging requirements: terraform vars example, OCI artifact layout, helm values for private installs, KMS key rotation note. Test matrix will include env permutations and data retention settings.

mia: Thanks all. I'll drop the SignalPath invite and attach the owners doc. Follow up after kickoff. :calendar:
